descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S14 Switch patient and context between questions, with an unsaved draft — no cross-patient bleed

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 3; UAT 3.4)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Patient A has lisinopril held; patient B (second Hospital patient) has an empty tracker; NH resident C has acetaminophen

When Ask meds on A; type an unsaved draft on A's Encounter tab and ask symptoms; go back, open B, ask symptoms and meds; switch to Nursing Home, open C, ask meds; type an unsaved draft on C's Encounter tab and ask symptoms

Then A's answers reflect A (including the unsaved draft); B's answers carry nothing of A; C's answer names only acetaminophen; C's draft answer is recorded for Q9

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs on the answer only (scope after 'Patient Record'): cp1 Lisinopril + held; cp2 'black stools' (the Hospital Encounter context includes the unsaved draft by design); cp3/cp4 for B mustNotContain 'black stools', 'Lisinopril', A's name; cp5 for C acetaminophen and none of A's facts or names; cp6 recorded, not judged (Q9)

Where it ran: dev unit U39; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
